theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_lhr_dq_uniform_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (a : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Φ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (xb e : Rn n) (R : ℝ), 0 < α → α ≤ 1 → IsOpen U → 0 < R → closedBall xb (4 * R) ⊆ U → ‖e‖ ≤ 1 → (∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => a x P Q) U ∧ ∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (fun z => a z P Q) x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (fun z => a z P Q) y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → (∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => Φ x P) U ∧ ∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (fun z => Φ z P) x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (fun z => Φ z P) y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → IsLocallyHolderCkα 1 α v U → ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ d : ℝ, d ≠ 0 → |d| < R → (∀ x ∈ ball xb (2 * R), ‖d⁻¹ • (v (x + d • e) - v x)‖ ≤ M) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun z => d⁻¹ • (v (z + d • e) - v z)) (ball xb (2 * R)) ∧ (∀ x ∈ ball xb (2 * R), fderiv ℝ (fun z => d⁻¹ • (v (z + d • e) - v z)) x = d⁻¹ • (fderiv ℝ v (x + d • e) - fderiv ℝ v x)) ∧ (∃ K : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ ball xb (2 * R), ∀ y ∈ ball xb (2 * R), ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => d⁻¹ • (v (z + d • e) - v z)) x - fderiv ℝ (fun z => d⁻¹ • (v (z + d • e) - v z)) y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) ∧ ∀ x ∈ ball xb (2 * R), ∀ y ∈ ball xb (2 * R), ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |(d⁻¹ * (Φ (x + d • e) P - Φ x P) - d⁻¹ * (a (x + d • e) (fderiv ℝ v (x + d • e)) P - a x (fderiv ℝ v (x + d • e)) P)) - (d⁻¹ * (Φ (y + d • e) P - Φ y P) - d⁻¹ * (a (y + d • e) (fderiv ℝ v (y + d • e)) P - a y (fderiv ℝ v (y + d • e)) P))| ≤ M * ‖x - y‖ ^ α * ‖P‖
